validation_runtime.statement: The automated validator executes committed Python rules against archived files and does not call an AI model. Manual reviews and the historical AI-assisted evidence pilot remain separately labeled.

agentic_evidence_runtime.scope: 18-case bounded agent-system benchmark with two three-run repeatability probes
agentic_evidence_runtime.authority: candidate evidence retrieval only; no dataset validation, human-review, or release-write authority

limitations: The archived prompt and available metadata document development provenance but do not guarantee identical regeneration of AI-assisted code. Model generation can be nondeterministic and the exact backend model build was not exposed.
